# Goodreads

> > The world's largest book discovery and reading community platform, featuring curated lists, genre browsing, reader recommendations, and literary quotes.

Goodreads, founded by Otis Chandler, connects readers with books through personalized recommendations, community-curated Listopia rankings, and social reading features. The platform covers everything from classic literature by Jane Austen and George Orwell to contemporary bestsellers and niche communities like Archive of Our Own (AO3) fanfiction.

## Key Topics

- Book discovery and recommendations
- Listopia curated rankings
- Classic literature (Pride and Prejudice, 1984, Jane Eyre, The Great Gatsby)
- Reading community and social features
- Genre classification and browsing
- Book ratings and reviews
- Literary novels and fiction
- Author profiles (Jane Austen, George Orwell, F. Scott Fitzgerald, Charlotte Brontë)
- Reading challenges
- Popular book quotes
- User-generated shelves and lists
- Most-read weekly rankings
- Archive of Our Own (AO3) fanfiction community
- Goodreads Serious Literature Group

## Platform Overview

- [Goodreads | Meet your next favorite book](https://goodreads.com): Homepage for Goodreads book discovery and reading community platform
- [About Goodreads](https://goodreads.com/about/us): Company mission, founder story, and overview of Goodreads platform
- [Genres](https://goodreads.com/genres): Browse directory of book genres and categories on Goodreads

## Book Discovery & Rankings

- [Most Read Books This Week In The United States](https://goodreads.com/book/most_read): Weekly ranking of most-read books by US Goodreads members
- [Goodreads Top 100 Literary Novels of All Time](https://goodreads.com/list/show/13086.Goodreads_Top_100_Literary_Novels_of_All_Time): Curated Listopia ranking of top 100 literary novels by Serious Lit Group
- [Goodreads Top 100 - Highest Rated Books](https://goodreads.com/list/show/153860.Goodreads_Top_100_Highest_Rated_Books_on_Goodreads_with_at_least_10_000_Ratings): Top 100 highest-rated books with 10K+ ratings, minimum 4.57 average
- [100 Best Books of All Time: The World Library List](https://goodreads.com/list/show/9440.100_Best_Books_of_All_Time_The_World_Library_List): World Library's 100 best books voted by 100 writers across 54 countries

## Community Features

- [Popular Quotes](https://goodreads.com/quotes): Most-liked quotes from Wilde, Monroe, Einstein and other famous authors
- [Ao3 Books](https://goodreads.com/shelf/show/ao3): User shelf featuring Archive of Our Own fanfiction books like Manacled

## Optional

- [Introduction to Arduino by Christina Bagain](https://goodreads.com/book/show/44795042-introduction-to-arduino): Arduino tutorial guide with step-by-step instructions
- [Introduction to Arduino 2nd Edition](https://goodreads.com/book/show/52939593-introduction-to-arduino-2nd-edition): Updated 2nd edition of Arduino fundamentals guide
- [Super Mario Odyssey Tutorials](https://goodreads.com/book/show/57204292-super-mario-odyssey-tutorials): Game walkthrough and strategy guide for Super Mario Odyssey
- [How to Draw for Beginners by Nora Layne](https://goodreads.com/en/book/show/235745117-how-to-draw-for-beginners---a-complete-step-by-step-guide-from-simple-sh): Beginner drawing workbook with practice pages and videos
- [Drawing Digital by Lisa Bardot](https://goodreads.com/book/show/131339534-drawing-digital): iPad digital art guide for drawing and painting tutorials
- [The New Artist's Guide to Drawing](https://goodreads.com/book/show/195717175-the-new-artist-s-guide-to-drawing): Drawing instruction covering people, animals, landscapes
- [The Beginner's Guide to Procreate](https://goodreads.com/book/show/65212418-the-beginner-s-guide-to-procreate): Procreate beginner guide for mastering digital art
- [Draw Like an Artist: 100 Flowers and Plants](https://goodreads.com/book/show/50187006-draw-like-an-artist): Botanical line drawing tutorial with 100 flowers/plants
- [The Artist's Complete Guide to Figure Drawing](https://goodreads.com/book/show/574647.The_Artist_s_Complete_Guide_to_Figure_Drawing): Figure drawing guide on classical artistic techniques
